sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {CLIENT} asked for a revised quote with the volume discount.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I can do that.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, so {S2|owner} sends {CLIENT} the revised quote by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yep.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Did you see that {CLIENT} wants the volume discount in the quote?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I did, can you redo it?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sure.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks, so {S2|owner} will have the new quote out by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: For the {CLIENT} renewal we need two things.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner} will update the contract terms by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: And I'll set up a call with their procurement lead.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sounds good.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What do we still need for the {CLIENT} renewal?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Updated contract terms and a call with procurement.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner}, can you take the terms by {DATE_REL|deadline}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes, no problem.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'll organise the procurement call myself.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The demo with {CLIENT} went well, and they want pricing for {NUMBER} seats.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {NUMBER}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Nice, {S2|owner}, can you send them a proposal by {DATE_REL|deadline}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Will do.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: How did the {CLIENT} demo go?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Really well, they asked for pricing on {NUMBER} seats.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {NUMBER}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, so a proposal from {S2|owner} by {DATE_REL|deadline}, then.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yep, on it.
